summary: `fractal missions show` lists a program step's journal keys under the step (status, duration, failure, the child run or ask a key waits on) and `fractal missions waiting-on` names its innermost open key; a program step is never shown as `watching`, and one whose journal has no new entry within its `stalled-after` stalls its run

replay.detail: No claim kind or projection change. Views read the existing `program.step` claims through the subject/kind claims page the engine's replay already uses.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change. The client v0 schema gains the work `gate_kind` value `program` and the optional work field `program`.

compatibility.detail: `GET /v1/mission-runs/{run}` and the mission tree carry `programs` (omitted when a run has no program step). Published work rows of program steps carry `gate_kind: program` instead of `watch`, and a `program` object (innermost open key, its start, its child, last entry, stalled-after); clients that matched `watch` for agentless steps without gates now see `program` for program steps. Waiting-on adds the open-step kind `program`; a program step past its `stalled-after` (default 30 minutes) is `no-progress`. Generated TypeScript, Swift and Rust clients model the new field.

downtime.detail: No restart or migration beyond a normal deploy.

recovery.detail: The fields are read-only presentation; reverting removes them.
